description: User-installable hi-res recipe for Zelda - Ocarina of Time (USA) Rev 0: 640x240 PROGRESSIVE (no interlace). Emulator-verified through the whole boot chain (logo -> title -> File Select -> gameplay) in mupen64plus. Not yet on real hardware in this form: the 2026-09-13 round tested a build without the z-buffer relocation, so this one is still EXPERIMENTAL. Copy this file into ~/.n64patcher/patches/ and put the .bps next to it - the loader resolves an operation's file against the recipe's own directory first. Requires an Expansion Pak.

patches.name: Zelda - Ocarina of Time (USA) Rev 0 - 640x240p (EXPERIMENTAL)
patches.source: N64-Universal-Smart-Patcher project - built from the zeldaret/oot decomp, see scripts/oot_hires/
patches.notes: 640x240 progressive: the boot VI tables (osViModeNtscLan1/MpalLan1) carry a 640-wide 1:1 mode - VI_WIDTH 0x280, VI_X_SCALE 0x400, stock 108/748 H_START window (NTSC 1.0 never re-issues osViSetMode). gScreenWidth is widened (.data + Main boot + ViMode_Update NOP), the framebuffer pair grows to 2x 640x240 and the 8MB fb-end moves to the Expansion Pak area so the game heap keeps its stock size. View_Init widens the viewport so the 3D fills the width. gZBuffer is relocated to 0x8056A000 (--zrel): the 640-wide scissor makes the RDP write 0x4B000 bytes of depth, which overflowed the stock 320x240 z-buffer into gGfxSPTaskOutputBuffer - the emulator survived that, hardware is not expected to. Cosmetic leftovers of the relocation: the CPU-side depth readers keep their 320 stride (sun glare/glow falloff) and the pause-menu prerender saves 320-wide. Title and File Select land correctly; dialogs/HUD with compile-time 320 positions stay upper-left (per-renderer 2D pass pending). Needs an Expansion Pak.
patches.outputs_note: Declared safely here (unlike the code-segment-only routes): the 640p patch edits the boot VI tables inside the CIC-6102 checksum window, so the restamped output ROM has its own CRC pair and cannot self-key the clean dump. Note the converse when verifying a build by CRC alone: everything outside the first megabyte - the ovl_file_choose debug edits among them - leaves this pair unchanged.
